race.comment: LITTLE ROCKET (3) is the one to beat after breaking through at this track over 1200m, settling rearward, covering ground and still finding enough to win by just under a length. His Gawler run prior had merit too, with traffic at the 350m and interference near the 100m before he was beaten just under three lengths. Suited for this race, can contest. BIG MAV (2) drops out of a BM70 after finishing tenth here and his proven track-and-distance record means he can rebound. Look for an improved run. VOLTAGE POINT (5) comes back from Saturday company after a fair seventh at Morphettville Parks, only beaten just over three lengths, and the return of Jake Toeroek is a genuine positive given their record together. Include. NOLABELL (11) was beaten just under a length in a BM70 at Morphettville Parks after starting near the top of betting, and her earlier five-length maiden win at this track showed enough to keep her right in the winning mix
